description: Negamax computes the minimax score with one rule instead of two: every position takes its highest child score. Each score is seen from the side that moved into the position, so a child's score is negated where the view switches. Textbook negamax negates at every ply; here a score is negated only where the side to move changes, so games where one side moves several times in a row are searched correctly. It returns the same score and principal variation as minimax.

papers.authors: Donald E. Knuth, Ronald W. Moore
papers.title: An analysis of alpha-beta pruning
